hypothesis: A byte-preserving 32x32 transpose may improve contiguous destination writes during KV packing beyond the existing reusable scratch candidate.
supported_shapes: Packed attention QH=16,capacity=1024; slidingKVH=8,HD=256,W=1024 or globalKVH=1,HD=512; tokens1..4096 for sliding, up to1024 global. Full disaggregated route remains prompt+decoded inputs<=1024. Other valid layouts use the existing reusable packer; malformed lengths fail before mutation.
fallback: No selection changes production defaults. Unsupported Metal/resource shapes use original kernels; ANE graph APIs reject before private calls and require explicit baseline re-selection; unsupported valid CPU layouts use old reusable packer.
additional_strata: AC, low-power-on, other pmset modes and Fair must be new independent pins/experiments; no conversion or pooling.
baseline: --kv-import-packing reuse-scratch, NOT merely the allocating historical default. Retain allocating baseline as a secondary reference, clearly labeled.

bounded_schedule.kind: manual A-before / B / A-after, separate owners/processes; not scheduled by these files
bounded_schedule.drift_action: reject this block and retain every receipt; no rescaling

qualification_before_timing: Exact every-byte equality with independent allocating packer, including Q slots, mask row, alignment padding, FP16 NaN payloads, infinities, subnormals and signed zero. Canary prefix/suffix must be untouched.
Test tokens0,1,31,32,33,84,1023,1024,1027,4096 sliding and0..1024 global; small unsupported layout fallback; incorrect lengths and overflow must leave destination unchanged.
End-to-end CLI uses finite real KV and unchanged surface writes; exact final token path. Do not call this an ANE/GPU kernel speedup.

accept_reject.scope: advance to another independently pinned confirmation, never auto-promote production
accept: Power/thermal labels remain exactly the pinned stratum and baseline bracket drift is <=5%.
Candidate target-stage median is at least5% lower than BOTH baseline-arm medians.
End-to-end request median is no more than2% above the worse baseline-arm median.
Report raw samples and uncertainty; require a second independent passing block before proposing admission.
reject: Any oracle mismatch, nonfinite valid-data output, cache miss, driver/compiler error, unexpected dispatch fallback, OOB/canary fault, changed work count, stratum transition, or drift>5%.
A speed-only win that fails quality is rejected.
An inconclusive/noisy or <5% target-stage result is not an accepted optimization.

measurement_target: CPU packer wall/allocation count first; then ane_cache_import_ms and prefill+KV-import wall
risks: Extra stack copying may lose to direct writes.
It deliberately retains full-surface zeroing;341MiB of zero fill per48-layer import is not removed.
Import wall includes original surface upload overhead; timing only that aggregate cannot isolate CPU transpose.
Scratch reuse was already implemented in the baseline; no credit for that existing optimization.
invocation_limits: This array is documentation, not a runnable trial or accepted queue manifest.

Repeat --hf-reference with explicitly pinned inputs to form each bounded warmup/measured arm. Reference files carry their own token/output budget; --max-new-tokens is not relied on for reference mode.
No attempt ledger, STOP marker, process allowlist or queue entry is supplied or modified.
Initialization/compilation is excluded from steady-state timing and reported separately. No auto-download or compile-on-miss.
Use the same retained-Metal policy in all arms; the supplied historical baseline is not a substitute for these controls.
